summary: One online lookout list places a tower at Cogdell, Clinch County, at 182 ft. No other source names it, and none describes the site today.

evidence.supports: Population figure is as of the 2020 census
Area 0.89 sq mi (2.31 km2), no water
Community elevation 186 ft in the infobox
List entry: Cogdell, Clinch County, 182 ft, tag gfc-821

notes_for_editor: Thin record. One online list (tnlandforms.us, tag gfc-821 as printed) is the only source found that names a tower at Cogdell. Two web searches found nothing more about a tower here. The NHLR Georgia list names a Fargo Fire Tower in Clinch County, and the eastern lookouts list places Fargo there too. Its point (30.68657, -82.56090) is more than 50 km from Cogdell, so this record is not linked to Fargo. The 182 ft list value and the 186 ft Wikipedia figure for the community measure different things. The brief's 'GFC US 821' register entry does not appear in any source read. The 'gfc' tag's meaning is not explained on the list page.
